```{r import-clean}
input_path <- path.expand(params$input_file)
absolute_path <- grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|\\\\\\\\)", input_path)
if (absolute_path && !file.exists(input_path)) {

stopifnot(nrow(raw)>0L, all(is.finite(raw$Biomass_g)),
          all(raw$Biomass_g>0), all(raw$Block %in% 1:4),
          all(raw$Treatment %in% 1:4))
raw$Collection_date <- as.Date(raw$Collection_date)
raw$Weighing_date <- as.Date(raw$Weighing_date)

# The updated source is already corrected. No observation is deleted here.

excluded$Reason <- character(0)
write_csv(excluded, "Excluded_record.csv")

clean$Area_m2 <- clean$Area_original_m2

if (any(!is.finite(clean$Area_m2)) || any(abs(clean$Area_m2-expected_area)>1e-8)) {

clean$Species[clean$Species=="UNKNOWNN DICOTS"] <- "UNKNOWN DICOTS"

# No cereal rye record is present; do not create one or add a taxon for it.
cover_crop_labels <- c("TRFAL", "BERSEEM", "BERSEEM CLOVER", "CEREAL RYE", "SECALE CEREALE")

    "Unresolved volunteer identity", "Recorded taxon code"))
clean$Include_primary <- clean$Broad_category=="Weed"
clean$Include_sensitivity <- clean$Broad_category=="Weed" &

```

### Biological categories and taxonomic uncertainty

| Broad category | Included records | Use in weed analysis |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Volunteer | `CLOVER`, a previous-season volunteer | Excluded from every weed diversity analysis |
| Weed | All recorded weeds, including every `UNKNOWN` group | Included in the primary Total weeds analysis |
| Cover crop | Berseem clover (`TRFAL`) and cereal rye | Excluded from every weed diversity analysis |

Total weeds includes the recorded weed codes and UNKNOWN groups. Its richness
counts recorded categories, not confirmed species. The sensitivity analysis
excludes UNKNOWN groups. Volunteer and Cover crop are excluded from both.

```{r categories}
category_summary <- aggregate(Biomass_g ~ Broad_category, clean, sum)
category_summary$Records <- as.integer(table(clean$Broad_category)[category_summary$Broad_category])
category_summary$Percent_of_recorded_mass <-
  100*category_summary$Biomass_g/sum(category_summary$Biomass_g)
stopifnot(all(category_summary$Broad_category %in%
  c("Volunteer", "Weed", "Cover crop")))
write_csv(category_summary, "Category_mass_summary.csv")
show_table(category_summary)
```

## Quadrat-level indices and independent plot means

For positive recorded masses in a quadrat, let \(p_i=b_i/\sum b_i\).
Richness \(S\) counts positive taxon/category records after summing repeated
records for the same label. Inverse Simpson diversity is
\(D_2=1/\sum p_i^2\), and Simpson evenness is \(E=D_2/S\).
The latter uses diversity divided by richness, not dominance divided by
richness. If all included masses are zero, richness is 0 and diversity and
evenness are undefined (`NA`). The supplied dataset is checked for this case.

Each index is calculated separately within each quadrat, then averaged within
each block × treatment × sampling stratum. Thus, every experimental plot
contributes one independent observation per stratum. T1 has four quadrats and
the other plot–stratum combinations have two. Pooling all T1 quadrats before
counting taxa would inflate its sampling effort relative to the other groups;
this analysis uses the mean quadrat index instead.

```{r indices}
meta_cols <- c("Sample_ID", "Block", "Treatment", "Quadrat", "Location",
               "Stratum", "Area_m2", "Cutting_height_cm", "Collection_date")
samples <- unique(clean[meta_cols])
stopifnot(nrow(samples)==64L, !anyDuplicated(samples$Sample_ID))
write_csv(samples, "Sample_metadata.csv")
metrics <- c("Richness", "Inverse_Simpson", "Simpson_evenness")

# Complete categories only for the 64 sampled quadrats. A missing category
# within one of these sampled quadrats has zero recorded category biomass.
# This does not create a missing sample, a rye record, or a new taxon label.
category_grid <- expand.grid(Sample_ID=as.character(samples$Sample_ID),
  Broad_category=c("Volunteer", "Weed", "Cover crop"), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
observed_category_mass <- aggregate(Biomass_g ~ Sample_ID + Broad_category, clean, sum)
category_quadrats <- merge(category_grid, observed_category_mass,
  by=c("Sample_ID", "Broad_category"), all.x=TRUE, sort=TRUE)
category_quadrats$Biomass_g[is.na(category_quadrats$Biomass_g)] <- 0
category_quadrats <- merge(category_quadrats, samples, by="Sample_ID", sort=TRUE)
category_quadrats$Biomass_g_m2 <- category_quadrats$Biomass_g/category_quadrats$Area_m2
stopifnot(nrow(category_quadrats)==192L,
  abs(sum(category_quadrats$Biomass_g)-sum(clean$Biomass_g))<1e-8,
  identical(sort(unique(category_quadrats$Broad_category)),
            sort(c("Volunteer", "Weed", "Cover crop"))))
category_plot_keys <- c("Block", "Treatment", "Stratum", "Broad_category")
category_plots <- aggregate(category_quadrats[c("Biomass_g", "Biomass_g_m2")],
  category_quadrats[category_plot_keys], mean)
category_n <- aggregate(category_quadrats["Sample_ID"],
  category_quadrats[category_plot_keys], length)
names(category_n)[names(category_n)=="Sample_ID"] <- "N_quadrats"
category_plots <- merge(category_plots, category_n, by=category_plot_keys)
names(category_plots)[names(category_plots)=="Biomass_g"] <- "Mean_quadrat_biomass_g"
names(category_plots)[names(category_plots)=="Biomass_g_m2"] <- "Mean_biomass_g_m2"
category_treatments <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(category_plots,
  interaction(category_plots$Treatment, category_plots$Stratum,
              category_plots$Broad_category, drop=TRUE)), function(z) {
  cbind(z[1, c("Treatment", "Stratum", "Broad_category")],
    data.frame(N_plots=nrow(z),
      Mean_quadrat_biomass_g=mean(z$Mean_quadrat_biomass_g),
      SD_quadrat_biomass_g=sd(z$Mean_quadrat_biomass_g),
      SE_quadrat_biomass_g=sd(z$Mean_quadrat_biomass_g)/sqrt(nrow(z)),
      Mean_biomass_g_m2=mean(z$Mean_biomass_g_m2),
      SD_biomass_g_m2=sd(z$Mean_biomass_g_m2),
      SE_biomass_g_m2=sd(z$Mean_biomass_g_m2)/sqrt(nrow(z))))
}))
rownames(category_treatments) <- NULL
write_csv(category_quadrats, "Category_biomass_by_quadrat.csv")
write_csv(category_plots, "Category_biomass_plot_means.csv")
write_csv(category_treatments, "Category_biomass_treatment_summary.csv")

calculate_indices <- function(include_column, analysis_name) {
  included <- clean[clean[[include_column]], ]
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(j) {
    id <- samples$Sample_ID[j]
    z <- included[included$Sample_ID==id, ]
    masses <- if (nrow(z)) tapply(z$Biomass_g, z$Species, sum) else numeric()
    masses <- masses[is.finite(masses) & masses>0]
    S <- length(masses)
    D2 <- if (S) 1/sum((masses/sum(masses))^2) else NA_real_
    all_mass <- sum(clean$Biomass_g[clean$Sample_ID==id])
    total_weed_mass <- sum(clean$Biomass_g[clean$Sample_ID==id & clean$Broad_category=="Weed"])
    cbind(samples[j, ], data.frame(Analysis=analysis_name,
      Included_mass_g=sum(masses), Recorded_mass_g=all_mass,
      Total_weed_mass_g=total_weed_mass,
      Omitted_fraction_of_total_weed_mass=if (total_weed_mass>0)
        1-sum(masses)/total_weed_mass else NA_real_, Richness=S,
      Inverse_Simpson=D2, Simpson_evenness=if (S) D2/S else NA_real_))
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
quadrats <- rbind(calculate_indices("Include_primary", "Total weeds"),
  calculate_indices("Include_sensitivity", "Identified weed codes"))
if (any(quadrats$Richness==0)) {
  stop("An empty included community was found. Review zero-sample handling before fitting models.")
}
stopifnot(all(quadrats$Inverse_Simpson>=1-1e-10),
  all(quadrats$Inverse_Simpson<=quadrats$Richness+1e-10),
  all(quadrats$Simpson_evenness<=1+1e-10))
group_cols <- c("Analysis", "Block", "Treatment", "Stratum")
plot_means <- aggregate(quadrats[metrics], quadrats[group_cols], mean)
nq <- aggregate(quadrats["Sample_ID"], quadrats[group_cols], length)
names(nq)[names(nq)=="Sample_ID"] <- "N_quadrats"
plot_means <- merge(plot_means, nq, by=group_cols, sort=TRUE)
stopifnot(nrow(plot_means)==56L)
write_csv(quadrats, "Quadrat_indices.csv")
write_csv(plot_means, "Plot_mean_indices.csv")
show_table(plot_means[plot_means$Analysis=="Total weeds", ])
```

## Biomass by broad category

The table reports Volunteer, Weed and Cover crop separately. Weed includes
all unidentified weed groups. A zero means no mass was recorded for that
category in a sampled quadrat; it does not introduce a species record.
Plot-level values are mean quadrat masses and mean mass per square metre,
so T1's four quadrats do not receive twice the weight of two-quadrat plots.
Treatment summaries use four independent plot means. Values from the two
sampling strata remain separate because area and cutting height differ.

```{r category-biomass-results}
show_table(category_treatments[c("Stratum", "Treatment", "Broad_category", "N_plots",
  "Mean_quadrat_biomass_g", "Mean_biomass_g_m2", "SE_biomass_g_m2")])
```

## Primary mowing comparisons: T2–T4

For each stratum and endpoint, the model is `index ~ Block + Treatment` with
four fixed block effects and three treatment levels. Analysis is on the
original index scale. With one plot per treatment in each block, treatment ×
block interaction is not separately estimable. Quadrats are subsamples and
are not treated as treatment replicates. The collection dates are associated
with blocks (B1/B3 on September 9; B2/B4 on September 11), not repeated
measurements of each plot, so a separate date effect is not estimated.

The primary p value is an exact randomization test of the treatment F
statistic, allowing all 3! treatment-label permutations independently within
each block (\(6^4=1,296\) assignments). This tests the sharp no-treatment-effect
null under the stated randomized design. Parametric F-test results are
reported alongside it. Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment is applied jointly to
the six primary exact p values (three endpoints × two strata). This is FDR
control, not familywise error control. Model-based Tukey pairwise comparisons
are supplementary and adjusted within each endpoint/stratum, not across the
entire report.

```{r test-functions}
permutations <- function(v) {
  if (length(v)==1L) return(matrix(v, nrow=1L))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(v), function(i)
    cbind(v[i], permutations(v[-i]))))
}
rcbd_f <- function(Y) {
  b <- nrow(Y); k <- ncol(Y); grand <- mean(Y)
  SST <- sum((Y-grand)^2)
  SSB <- k*sum((rowMeans(Y)-grand)^2)
  SSTrt <- b*sum((colMeans(Y)-grand)^2)
  SSE <- max(0, SST-SSB-SSTrt)
  (SSTrt/(k-1))/(SSE/((b-1)*(k-1)))
}
exact_rcbd <- function(Y) {
  stopifnot(nrow(Y)==4L, ncol(Y)==3L, all(is.finite(Y)))
  b <- nrow(Y); k <- ncol(Y)
  P <- permutations(seq_len(k))
  assignments <- as.matrix(expand.grid(rep(list(seq_len(nrow(P))), b)))
  sums <- matrix(0, nrow(assignments), k)
  for (i in seq_len(b)) {
    candidate <- matrix(Y[i, ][P], nrow=nrow(P), ncol=k)
    sums <- sums + candidate[assignments[, i], , drop=FALSE]
  }
  grand <- mean(Y)
  fixed_ss <- sum((Y-grand)^2)-k*sum((rowMeans(Y)-grand)^2)
  ss_trt <- b*rowSums((sums/b-grand)^2)
  ss_error <- pmax(0, fixed_ss-ss_trt)
  F_all <- (ss_trt/(k-1))/(ss_error/((b-1)*(k-1)))
  observed <- rcbd_f(Y)
  list(F=observed, p=mean(F_all>=observed-1e-10), assignments=length(F_all))
}

run_models <- function(analysis_name, include_control=FALSE) {
  test_rows <- list(); emm_rows <- list(); pair_rows <- list(); diagnostic_rows <- list()
  models <- list()
  strata <- if (include_control) "Cover_crop" else c("Cover_crop", "Broccoli")
  for (stratum in strata) for (metric in metrics) {
    d <- plot_means[plot_means$Analysis==analysis_name & plot_means$Stratum==stratum, ]
    if (!include_control) d <- d[d$Treatment!="T1", ]
    d$Block <- factor(d$Block)
    d$Treatment <- droplevels(factor(d$Treatment))
    fit <- lm(reformulate(c("Block", "Treatment"), response=metric), data=d)
    reduced <- lm(reformulate("Block", response=metric), data=d)
    a <- anova(reduced, fit)
    key <- paste(analysis_name, stratum, metric, sep="__")
    models[[key]] <- fit
    if (!include_control) {
      Y <- as.matrix(xtabs(reformulate(c("Block", "Treatment"), response=metric), data=d))
      exact <- exact_rcbd(Y)
      stopifnot(abs(exact$F-a$F[2])<1e-7)
    } else exact <- list(p=NA_real_, assignments=NA_integer_)
    test_rows[[key]] <- data.frame(Analysis=analysis_name, Stratum=stratum,
      Metric=metric, N_plots=nrow(d), F=a$F[2], df1=a$Df[2],
      df2=df.residual(fit), Parametric_p=a$`Pr(>F)`[2],
      Exact_p=exact$p, Permutations=exact$assignments)
    em <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~Treatment)
    emtab <- as.data.frame(summary(em, infer=c(TRUE, FALSE)))
    emtab$Analysis <- analysis_name; emtab$Stratum <- stratum; emtab$Metric <- metric
    emm_rows[[key]] <- emtab
    pa <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(em), infer=c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust="tukey"))
    pa$Analysis <- analysis_name; pa$Stratum <- stratum; pa$Metric <- metric
    pair_rows[[key]] <- pa
    sh <- shapiro.test(residuals(fit))
    diagnostic_rows[[key]] <- data.frame(Analysis=analysis_name, Stratum=stratum,
      Metric=metric, Residual_SD=sigma(fit), Shapiro_W=unname(sh$statistic),
      Shapiro_p=sh$p.value, Max_Cooks_distance=max(cooks.distance(fit)))
  }
  tests <- do.call(rbind, test_rows); rownames(tests) <- NULL
  tests$Exact_p_BH <- if (!include_control) p.adjust(tests$Exact_p, "BH") else NA_real_
  tests$Parametric_p_BH <- p.adjust(tests$Parametric_p, "BH")
  list(tests=tests, emmeans=do.call(rbind, emm_rows),
       pairs=do.call(rbind, pair_rows), diagnostics=do.call(rbind, diagnostic_rows),
       models=models)
}
primary <- run_models("Total weeds")
sensitivity <- run_models("Identified weed codes")
secondary <- run_models("Total weeds", include_control=TRUE)
write_csv(primary$tests, "Primary_T2_T4_tests.csv")
write_csv(primary$emmeans, "Primary_T2_T4_emmeans.csv")
write_csv(primary$pairs, "Primary_T2_T4_Tukey_pairs.csv")
write_csv(primary$diagnostics, "Primary_model_diagnostics.csv")
write_csv(sensitivity$tests, "Sensitivity_identified_codes_T2_T4_tests.csv")
write_csv(sensitivity$emmeans, "Sensitivity_identified_codes_T2_T4_emmeans.csv")
write_csv(sensitivity$pairs, "Sensitivity_identified_codes_T2_T4_Tukey_pairs.csv")
write_csv(secondary$tests, "Secondary_T1_T4_Cover_crop_tests.csv")
write_csv(secondary$emmeans, "Secondary_T1_T4_Cover_crop_emmeans.csv")
write_csv(secondary$pairs, "Secondary_T1_T4_Cover_crop_Tukey_pairs.csv")
show_table(primary$tests)
```

### Estimated means and pairwise comparisons

These balanced-design marginal means equal the treatment averages of plot
means. Confidence intervals for means are pointwise 95% intervals from the
additive RCBD model. They are not constrained to the possible range of an
index. Each treatment has four independent plots. A nonsignificant difference
does not establish equivalent diversity.

```{r primary-tables}
show_table(primary$emmeans)
show_table(primary$pairs)
```

```{r primary-figure, fig.height=7}
d <- plot_means[plot_means$Analysis=="Total weeds" & plot_means$Treatment!="T1", ]
long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(metrics, function(m) {
  z <- d[c("Block", "Treatment", "Stratum")]
  z$Metric <- m; z$Value <- d[[m]]; z
}))
em <- primary$emmeans
p <- ggplot(long, aes(x=Treatment, y=Value)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=Block), position=position_dodge(width=0.25),
             size=2, colour="grey45") +
  geom_errorbar(data=em, aes(x=Treatment, ymin=lower.CL, ymax=upper.CL),
                inherit.aes=FALSE, width=0.12, linewidth=0.55) +
  geom_point(data=em, aes(x=Treatment, y=emmean), inherit.aes=FALSE,
             shape=18, size=3.5, colour="black") +
  facet_wrap(~Stratum+Metric, ncol=3, scales="free_y") +
  labs(x="Mowing treatment", y="Mean quadrat index",
       caption="Small symbols: independent plot means. Diamonds: RCBD marginal means. Bars: pointwise 95% model CIs.") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom", strip.text=element_text(size=9))
print(p)
ggsave(file.path(out, "Figures", "Primary_diversity.png"), p,
       width=11, height=7, dpi=300)
ggsave(file.path(out, "Figures", "Primary_diversity.pdf"), p,
       width=11, height=7)
```

## Sensitivity to unidentified weed groups

This table repeats the six mowing tests using only identified weed codes,
excluding unknown groups. Volunteer and Cover crop remain excluded in both
scenarios. BH correction is performed separately within these six sensitivity
tests. The exported quadrat table gives the fraction of Total weeds biomass
omitted from the identified-code scenario for every sample. In the primary
Total weeds scenario this omitted fraction is zero.

```{r sensitivity}
show_table(sensitivity$tests)
```

## Secondary management-system comparison including T1

This comparison uses only samples collected from 0.16 m² at the 8 cm cutting
height. The response remains mean quadrat diversity. T1 has four subsamples
per plot while T2–T4 have two, so plot-mean precision can differ by treatment.
Parametric additive RCBD results are exploratory and depend on the model's
variance assumptions. No exact randomization p value is claimed here.
T1 differs in crop presence and soil/vegetation management as well as mowing,
so this comparison cannot isolate a mowing effect. The three secondary
parametric p values are BH-adjusted separately from the primary family.

```{r secondary}
show_table(secondary$tests)
show_table(secondary$emmeans)
show_table(secondary$pairs)
```

## Model diagnostics and limitations

Inspect residual-versus-fitted plots and normal Q–Q plots before relying on
parametric intervals or Tukey tests. A nonsignificant Shapiro–Wilk result with
only 12 plot observations is not proof of normality. Primary randomization
tests avoid a normal-error requirement but still require the stated
randomization and the sharp-null interpretation.

```{r diagnostics-table}
show_table(primary$diagnostics)
```

```{r diagnostics-plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, results='hide'}
oldpar <- par(no.readonly=TRUE)
for (key in names(primary$models)) {
  fit <- primary$models[[key]]
  par(mfrow=c(1,2), mar=c(4,4,3,1))
  plot(fitted(fit), residuals(fit), xlab="Fitted", ylab="Residual",
       main=gsub("__", " / ", key), pch=19, cex.main=0.65)
  abline(h=0, lty=2)
  qqnorm(residuals(fit), main="Residual normal Q-Q", pch=19)
  qqline(residuals(fit))
}
par(oldpar)
```

- The input records biomass in grams but does not explicitly identify it as
  fresh or dry mass in its column heading. Report it as recorded biomass
  until the weighing protocol is confirmed.
- No individual counts are present. Density-based diversity, count-based
  rarefaction and Fisher's alpha are therefore not computed.
- Unknown weed groups prevent a definitive weed species-richness estimate.
  Total weeds richness counts recorded operational weed categories;
  Identified weed codes is a sensitivity subset. Volunteer clover is excluded
  from both and summarized separately as Volunteer biomass.
- Differences between broccoli-row and cover-crop-area indices are not tested
  as if sampling were equivalent: both area and clipping height differ.
- Plastic mulch is an adjacent production benchmark, and no corresponding
  species-level weed table is supplied. It is not added as a randomized fifth
  diversity treatment.
- Only this collection is analyzed. Dates assigned to different blocks do
  not establish a seasonal trajectory or two independent sampling rounds.
